subject: Opal AI \u0014 Technical deep dive (ML & infra) scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel@opal-ai.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@opal-ai.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Opal AI - Discovery recap & proposed next steps

Hi Daniel / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today - really useful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Key needs we heard:
  - High-throughput inference for 10k+ daily users (low 100s ms p95 target)
  - Tight data isolation and auditability for PHI
  - Ability to run both open and customer-finetuned models with predictable cost control

- Immediate next step:
  - Schedule a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra leads so our solutions/infra team can walk through architecture, performance expectations, and integration patterns.

Proposed agenda (60-90 min):
1) Introductions + goals (5-10m)
2) Current infra + model stack (15-20m) - Opal to share topology and constraints
3) Redwood architecture and relevant optimizations (20-25m) - continuous batching, KV cache, quantization options
4) Integration & security (15-20m) - VPC, KMS/HSM, audit logs, data flow
5) Open Q&A + next steps (10-15m)

Suggested time windows (PDT):
- Tue 4/7 10:00-11:30 (90m)
- Tue 4/7 14:00-15:30 (90m)
- Wed 4/8 09:00-10:00 (60m)

Attendees we'd like: Camila Reyes (Solutions Eng), Rishi Malhotra (Platform SE), myself. Can you confirm who from Opal would join (ML lead, platform/infra, security/compliance)?

I've attached a short pre-read with technical questions to help us prep (opal-technical-questions.pdf) and a proposed agenda (redwood-technical-deep-dive-agenda.md).

If these slots don't work, send a few alternatives and we'll align.

Thanks - excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference - production-first inference runtime for developers

From: Daniel Cho <daniel@opal-ai.com>

Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@opal-ai.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opal AI - Discovery recap & proposed next steps

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. The agenda looks good and the pre-read is helpful. A few quick notes from our side:

- Attendees: Priya (PM), myself (Head of ML), Arjun Rao (Platform lead, arjun.r@opal-ai.com), and our security lead, Laura Kim (laura.k@opal-ai.com) - Laura may join for the security portion only.
- Preferred times: Tue 4/7 14:00-15:30 PDT works best for the ML + infra folks; Arjun asked if we can target the 90-minute slot to allow for a short whiteboarding session on scaling.
- Goals: we want to understand how Redwood handles long-context models (16k+), model pinning/versioning during rollouts, and fallbacks for overloaded capacity.

If you can confirm the 4/7 14:00-15:30 slot and include dial-in details, we'll block calendars.

Thanks,
Daniel
Head of ML | Opal AI

From: Daniel Cho <daniel@opal-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@opal-ai.com>, Arjun Rao <arjun.r@opal-ai.com>, Laura Kim <laura.k@opal-ai.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opal AI - Technical deep dive (ML & infra) scheduling

Thanks Marissa - invite received and calendars blocked. Attaching a short topology diagram (we'll paste into the invite): opal-serving-topology-v2.pdf (will upload to the Drive folder).

Quick note on context: our production models are a mix of MPT-style open weights and a few proprietary finetuned checkpoints. We typically route requests through a gateway that handles auth and rate limits, then to a model cluster that uses autoscaling groups. We are particularly interested in:
- p95/p99 tail latency strategies for cached vs. cold starts
- model variant rollouts with traffic-splitting (canary -> A/B)
- SLOs and monitoring hooks (token-level cost visibility would be ideal)

See you all at 14:00 PDT.

- Daniel
